We already work with several leading Italian and international companies, and we’re now looking to further expand our presence in the Italian market
We need a native Italian speaker who wants to take the first steps in the Italian Learning&Development market, as an BDR.

## About the role

> This is a perfect position for:
>
> people who have been working as a BDR
>
> people who want to work in the sales department
>
> people who want to take part in building this amazing startup
>
> are fluent in Italian

![📌 Callout icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

This role is highly outbound-driven.
Cold calling is the most effective and prioritized channel
You will spend a significant part of your day speaking directly with prospects by phone

#### Responsibilities

Experience in cold calling

Daily outbound activity with a strong focus on cold calling

Book meetings through high-volume call sessions with HR leaders and decision makers

Test scripts, objections and angles directly on calls to accelerate learning

Use LinkedIn and email to support and warm up calls, not to replace them

Track and improve call performance inside HubSpot

#### Requirements

KNOWLEDGE

A real master in cold calling

Basic understanding of copywriting

Experience using a CRM, especially Hubspot

Strong communication in English (B2 level minimum)

Passion for startups and learning through practice

Self-starter mindset

Curiosity and resilience

Comfortable in fast-paced, flexible environments

We’re not looking for the “perfect” CV, we’re looking for the right person. If this sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

## Our Pack for you

### Compensation

€28.000 + €14.000 (€42.000 OTE uncapped)

### Contract

![](https://packworkspace.notion.site/icons/add_orange.svg?mode=light)

Submit your resume

Working hours: full time

Contract term: Permanent contract with a 6-month probation period

We have set a Performance Review System that applies to 50% of the RAL as a bonus but there is no cap. It means that if a person over-performs 100% and/or the company does so, bonuses will be linked to the over-performance.

### Benefits

Remote and flexible culture: you choose when, how and how much to work to meet your goals.

UNLIMITED MENTORING, COACHING & THERAPY SESSIONS: You will have the opportunity tofollow a mentoring or a coaching path directly on our platform. Moreover, you will also have access to therapy sessions, thanks to our partner [Serenis](https://www.serenis.it/).

WELFARE PLATFORM & MEAL VOUCHERS:  every month you will receive an amount on the [Edenred Application](https://www.edenred.es/) and you will decide how to spend it.
